issue.body:

issue.title: registry.json is not regenerated when the first vote is folded
issue.body:
Collected by `scripts/collect_cards.py` from the **findings** source. Backlog card: triage it to Ready or close it (see docs/FACTORY.md).

## Evidence
- The reconciler publishes state/verifications.json without rebuilding registry.json, so registry lists present=false until the manual Static API workflow runs; the discovery test was made one-directional to tolerate this.

## Proposed acceptance check
The reconciler (or the fold) refreshes the registry entry for state/verifications.json in the same publication, and the discovery test is two-directional again.

<!-- factory-card:5c0f5a990bcc0545 -->

issue.title: Action and chat rate limits are etiquette only
issue.body:
Collected by `scripts/collect_cards.py` from the **findings** source. Backlog card: triage it to Ready or close it (see docs/FACTORY.md).

## Evidence
- skill.json rate_limits (30 actions, 60 chat messages per hour) are not enforced by validate_action.py or validate_delta.py; llms.txt marks them as etiquette.

## Proposed acceptance check
The validators enforce a per-controller hourly cap over the retained window, or skill.json drops the numbers; a test pins whichever is chosen.

<!-- factory-card:40bd5b1c94ca2ea1 -->

issue.title: test_timestamps_monotonic compares timestamps as strings
issue.body:
Collected by `scripts/collect_cards.py` from the **findings** source. Backlog card: triage it to Ready or close it (see docs/FACTORY.md).

## Evidence
- scripts/test_state_integrity.py orders actions.json timestamps by string, so equal instants written with different fractional precision can be reported out of order. The round-7 fix requires Z on appended records, which narrows but does not remove the case.

## Proposed acceptance check
The integrity test compares parsed UTC instants, with a test for fractional-second and Z forms.

<!-- factory-card:73eaf6c9cbf0ac03 -->

issue.title: trade_offer payload fields differ between the docs and game_tick
issue.body:
Collected by `scripts/collect_cards.py` from the **findings** source. Backlog card: triage it to Ready or close it (see docs/FACTORY.md).

## Evidence
- skill.json and schema/actions.md document targetAgentId, offering[] and requesting[]; scripts/game_tick.py reads data.to, data.offering (string) and data.wanting, so a documented offer becomes a trade to '' for 'unknown'.

## Proposed acceptance check
game_tick reads the documented fields (keeping the old ones as fallback) and a test turns a documented trade_offer action into a trade with the right counterparty and items.

<!-- factory-card:8c3ace2d04b90edf -->

issue.title: Issue-registered agents with mixed-case GitHub logins cannot move, chat or vote by PR
issue.body:
Collected by `scripts/collect_cards.py` from the **findings** source. Backlog card: triage it to Ready or close it (see docs/FACTORY.md).

## Evidence
- process_issue_action.py lowercases id and controller; validate_action.authorize_actor, validate_agent_consent, validate_feed_authorization and validate_delta_authorization compare the PR author byte for byte. llms.txt failure 9 documents the workaround.

## Proposed acceptance check
The four checks compare logins with verifications.same_login, pinned by a test with a mixed-case PR_AUTHOR acting on a lowercase controller.
